Topbar.title: MDX Workbench
Topbar.localeHint: LocaleIdentifier sent with every Discover and Execute

Notice.formatNothing: Nothing to change: the query is already laid out, or it does not parse.
Notice.formatUnavailable: The language server cannot format this query.
Notice.shared: The link to this query is copied.
Notice.sharedNoClipboard: The link is in the address bar.
Notice.expandDesigner: Drilling down works on queries from the designer; for a written query, change the text.
Notice.noCatalogs: {{url}} answered, but lists no catalog to work in.

Welcome.title: An MDX workbench on your XMLA servers
Welcome.text: Connect to a server, pick a cube, and write MDX with completion, the syntax trees and a visual builder. Results show in the board's pivot table; every request is logged.

Connect.title: Connect to an XMLA server
Connect.name: Name
Connect.cubeFirst: The first one the catalogue lists
Connect.hint: The server must allow requests from this page (CORS), as the demo servers do.
Connect.failed: The server did not answer, so it was not added: {{error}}

Explorer.title: Explorer
Explorer.noHits: Nothing in the cube is called that.
Explorer.searchingServer: Searching the server for members not loaded yet…
Explorer.serverSearchFailed: Only the members already loaded were searched: the server could not be asked for the rest.
Explorer.noCube: No cube yet: connect to a server and pick one.

Editor.title: Query
Editor.shareHint: Copy a link that opens this query

Inspector.title: Inspector
Inspector.empty: Put the caret in the query or pick a node.

Builder.errors: The query does not parse; fix it and the builder follows.
Builder.noSelect: The builder shows a SELECT; this tab holds something else.
Builder.partial: Parse errors - the zones may be incomplete.
Builder.dropSlicer: drop a member to slice by it
Builder.subcubeHint: a set to restrict the cube to
Builder.tabular: The builder works on cube SELECTs only; this tab holds a schema rowset or a drillthrough.

Unparse.errors: The query does not parse, so it cannot be reprinted.
Unparse.unavailable: The language server cannot reprint this query.

Designer.hint: Drag hierarchies and measures from the cube tree onto the zones.

Results.nothing: Run a query to see its result here.
Results.noCellset: Done in {{ms}} ms - the statement answers with no cells.
Results.tooManyAxes: More than four axes: the list shows every cell.
Results.emptyAxis: Done in {{ms}} ms - an axis of the answer holds no members, so there is no cell to show.

Log.stoppedDetail: Stopped before the server answered - by Stop, a newer request or the timeout.

Chart.noWidget: The chart widget is not loaded.
Chart.failed: The chart could not be built: {{error}}
Chart.hint: The board's chart widget: one series per column of the answer, its rows along the axis.
Chart.noComposer: The board's chart composer is not loaded.
